questions.q: What two problems does distributing traffic across multiple backend instances solve?
options: Availability and scale — one instance can fail while others keep serving, and you add capacity incrementally
Encryption and compression, which only load balancers can perform
DNS resolution and IP address assignment
Subnet isolation and CIDR allocation
questions.explain: A load balancer improves availability (traffic keeps flowing if one instance fails) and scale (add more instances instead of one giant server).

questions.q: How does a Layer 4 load balancer decide where to send traffic?
options: By reading the full HTTP request body
By looking only at IP addresses and port numbers, without inspecting the request's content
By checking the URL path and cookies
By randomly selecting a backend with no criteria at all
questions.explain: Layer 4 (transport-layer) load balancing, like AWS's Network Load Balancer, routes based purely on IP and port — it's fast but blind to what's actually in the request.

questions.q: What can a Layer 7 load balancer do that a Layer 4 load balancer can't?
options: Route traffic based on application-layer content, such as sending /api/* to one backend pool and /images/* to another
Operate faster than any Layer 4 load balancer under all conditions
Encrypt traffic, which Layer 4 load balancers cannot do
Assign private IP addresses to backend instances
questions.explain: A Layer 7 load balancer, like AWS's Application Load Balancer, reads the actual HTTP request and can route by URL path, headers, or cookies — something a content-blind Layer 4 balancer can't do.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a health check in load balancing?
options: To periodically verify a backend instance is actually responding correctly before continuing to send it traffic
To measure how many total requests a load balancer has processed historically
To encrypt traffic between the load balancer and backend instances
To automatically increase a server's CPU allocation
questions.explain: Health checks let the load balancer stop routing traffic to an instance that's failing, which is the real mechanism behind the availability benefit of load balancing.

questions.q: Which AWS load balancer type is the real example of Layer 7, application-aware routing?
options: Network Load Balancer (NLB)
Application Load Balancer (ALB)
Internet Gateway
Network ACL
questions.explain: AWS's Application Load Balancer (ALB) operates at Layer 7 and can route by URL path, while the Network Load Balancer (NLB) operates at Layer 4.
